summary: The first public preview of MediaForge: save, convert and organize media you're permitted to save, on your own computer.
features: Paste a link to see every available quality, audio track and subtitle, then download with live progress.
A real download queue: several at once, pause and resume, retry, and recovery after a restart.
Converter for MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV and FLAC, running on your computer with FFmpeg.
Library with tags, duplicate detection and saved views; History records every step of every download.
Browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox: send the page you're on to MediaForge in one click.
Your own signed-in sessions (cookies.txt), kept in your system's secure credential store.
English, Khmer, Simplified Chinese and French.
notes: This preview isn't code-signed yet: macOS and Windows show a warning the first time you open it. The Download page explains how to continue.
Licences, checkout and automatic updates switch on in a later release. The preview runs on the Free plan (up to 720p, one download at a time).
